critical_code_review_comments: server.py — GET /orders/kds/board filters by date=strftime('%Y-%m-%d') stored on the order. This depends on the order-creation code path setting `date` in the same UTC format. Confirmed by curl in the test, but a legacy row without `date` field would silently be excluded from the board. Consider making the date filter tolerant (created_at gte start_of_day_utc) as a hardening step. Not blocking.

server.py — PUT /orders/{id}/kds-status validates the enum inside the handler even though a Pydantic Literal would fail earlier with 422. Current 400 is functionally fine; keep or switch to Literal[...] for consistency.

KitchenDisplayPage.jsx — On WS event 'order.kds_status' the page always calls load() (full board refetch). Cheap for now but for many concurrent kitchens/high-frequency updates consider applying the payload directly (payload already carries {id, kds_status}) to reduce round-trips.

KitchenDisplayPage.jsx — `beep()` uses a module-level singleton `audioCtx` that persists across route mounts. Some browsers require a user gesture to unlock the AudioContext; the toggle click provides one, but auto-loading /kitchen (Ctrl+click new tab) will not, so the first beep on a fresh tab may be silenced by autoplay policies. Consider explicitly resuming audioCtx on the first user gesture. Minor.

KitchenDisplayPage.jsx — knownIdsRef is refreshed after each load() but the new-order beep decision uses it BEFORE the load resolves; racy under fast successive events. Not a functional bug but worth a small refactor.
